title: a new environment switch not named NORN_* or missing from the env table (engine/lib/slop/env.md)
how: an env read (env.X, process.env.X, env['X']) of an upper-case name, keyed on the name tree-wide: new when no file of the base tree names it; a new NORN_* name listed in the env table engine/lib/slop/env.md passes

explain.what: The code reads a new environment variable that is not named NORN_* or has no row in engine/lib/slop/env.md.
explain.why: Hidden switches change behaviour without a trace. One prefix and one table let anyone find every switch and what it does.
explain.fix: Name it NORN_<something> and add its row to engine/lib/slop/env.md. Better still, use a setting or a flag.
